title: HELIX Bridge: Banner HR → Employee
saas_vs_onprem: Banner SaaS (Ellucian Cloud) uses the same underlying Oracle schema. Access methods differ: on-prem uses direct Oracle SQL; SaaS uses Ellucian Data Connect (EDC), Ethos Integration API, or Banner Integration API (BIA). Table/column names are identical across both deployment models.

source_tables.description: Employee base. Hire date, termination date, first work date, employee status, employee class, benefits category. One row per employee (current state).
Employee job detail. Position, title, department, salary, FTE, hours, supervisor, job change history. Effective-dated (multiple rows per employee over time).
Position base. Position number, title, budget, FTE, department, org, pay grade, status. One row per position.
Employee class validation. Defines employee classes (faculty full-time, faculty part-time, staff exempt, staff non-exempt, student, temp, etc.).
Person identification (shared with student module). Name, ID, PIDM.
Person biographical (shared). Birth date, gender, ethnicity, veteran status.
Finance organization. Org hierarchy codes linked to positions for financial reporting.

notes: Banner HR uses a position-centric model: NBBPOSN defines positions, NBRBJOB assigns employees to positions. This differs from PeopleSoft's job-record-centric model (PS_JOB). NBRBJOB is effective-dated — current row = max NBRBJOB_EFFECTIVE_DATE ≤ today. A single employee can have multiple NBRBJOB records for concurrent positions (e.g., faculty member with an administrative appointment). The shared PIDM between student and HR modules means Banner natively handles the 'faculty who are also students' scenario.
